That's the error. 

So the mistake was in Step 3 when the Planner incorrectly stated the burial place as the Pyramid of Khafre instead of the Great Pyramid. This confusion likely came from a misunderstanding or a mix-up between Khufu and Khafre, as both are associated with the pyramids but are different pharaohs.
